scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-builder/contracts && npm run build -w @paul-os/runtime && npm run build -w @agent-builder/generator-cli && npm run build -w @agent-builder/backend && npm run build -w @paul-os/worker && npm run build -w @agent-builder/frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @agent-builder/backend" "npm run dev -w @agent-builder/frontend"
scripts.start:worker: npm run build -w @paul-os/worker && npm run start -w @paul-os/worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p apps/backend/tsconfig.seed.json --pretty false && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.test: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:backend && npm run test:cli && npm run test:worker && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:prepare: npm run build -w @agent-builder/contracts && npm run build -w @paul-os/runtime && npm run build -w @agent-builder/generator-cli
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:backend -- --coverage && npm run test:worker -- --coverage && npm run test:frontend -- --coverage
scripts.generate:console-copy: npm run build -w @agent-builder/contracts && npm run build -w @paul-os/runtime && node packages/runtime/dist/cli.js console-copy generate 05-reference/console-critical-copy/fixtures/copy.json
scripts.check:console-copy: npm run build -w @agent-builder/contracts && npm run build -w @paul-os/runtime && node packages/runtime/dist/cli.js console-copy check 05-reference/console-critical-copy/fixtures/copy.json
scripts.certify:console-copy: npm run build -w @agent-builder/contracts && npm run build -w @paul-os/runtime && npm run build -w @agent-builder/backend && npm run certify:console-copy -w @agent-builder/backend
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @agent-builder/contracts && npm run build -w @paul-os/runtime && npm run db:seed -w @agent-builder/backend
